tables.schema:
CREATE TABLE meta (
          key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          value TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE rooms (
          room TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
          created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE epochs (
          room TEXT NOT NULL,
          epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
          base_update BLOB NOT NULL,
          snapshot_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
          next_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
          total_updates INTEGER NOT NULL,
          updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY (room, epoch)
        )

CREATE TABLE log (
          room TEXT NOT NULL,
          epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
          seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
          update_id TEXT,
          source TEXT NOT NULL,
          bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
          created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY (room, epoch, seq)
        )

CREATE TABLE dedup (
          room TEXT NOT NULL,
          epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
          update_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
          digest TEXT NOT NULL,
          byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL,
          created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY (room, epoch, update_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE checkpoints (
          room TEXT NOT NULL,
          checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
          epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
          update_bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
          created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY (room, checkpoint_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE restore_requests (
          room TEXT NOT NULL,
          request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
          expected_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
          result_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
          created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY (room, request_id)
        )
